## Timer.svelte

### `interface Props`
- `startButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the start button.
- `pauseButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the pause button.
- `resetButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the reset icon button.

- `mode` :: Timer direction: count down from `duration` or count up from zero.
- `duration` :: Initial countdown length (in milliseconds).
- `autoStart` :: Start running automatically on mount.
- `interval` :: Tick cadence in milliseconds.
- `showHours` :: Always display the hours segment even when under 1 hour.
- `showControls` :: Render Start/Pause and Reset controls beside the readout.
- `size` :: Readout text scale on the shared size ladder.
- `gap` :: The space between the readout and its controls.
- `onComplete` :: Called when a countdown reaches zero.
- `onTick` :: Called on each tick with the current elapsed or remaining milliseconds.
